label.purpose: Controls, state, time, latency, and logs.

shadows.name: compact-window
shadows.purpose: Separates the compact subtitle window from content behind it.

shadows.name: error-toast
shadows.purpose: Lifts transient error feedback above the workspace.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Switch thumbs, Toast entry, and latest-subtitle movement.

components.name: Primary Run Button
components.description: Starts a new source-specific session and is replaced by pause and stop controls while active.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" aria-label="Start session"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 3 14 9-14 9z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 5px; color: #fff; background: var(--teal); transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--teal-dark); background: var(--teal-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Command
components.description: Opens a secondary surface without competing with capture.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 37px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #a8b0b1; background: #fafbfb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Translation Field
components.description: Compact labeled field for language and model selection.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; color: var(--ink-faint); font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field select { height: 33px; padding: 0 30px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field select:hover { border-color: #9da7a8; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: Marks the current source page while preserving a dense control rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: grid; width: 190px; height: 42px; padding: 0 10px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 7px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: #fff; background: #303638; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-active i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #17a099; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #3a4143; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Listening Toggle
components.description: A compact semantic switch for binary capture and review settings.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--teal); } .ds-toggle span { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(18 29 29 / 24%); transform: translateX(16px); transition: transform 170ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--teal-dark); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Archive Rail
components.description: A full-height, source-specific save and export surface that collapses to a narrow reopen rail.
components.css: .ds-archive { display: flex; width: 300px; min-height: 320px; padding: 16px; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); color: var(--ink); background: #f5f6f6; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-archive header { font-size: 14px; } .ds-archive label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-archive input, .ds-archive button { height: 34px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; } .ds-archive button:hover { border-color: #9da7a8; background: #fafbfb; } .ds-archive input:focus-visible, .ds-archive button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A quiet, ruled Windows workspace where live translation owns the reading field and operational controls stay compact, factual, and close to native desktop expectations.
keyCharacteristics: White and cool-gray work surfaces with near-black text.
Listening teal is reserved for active state and primary action.
Bilingual paragraphs, not isolated translation cards, are the main content unit.
Each source page owns its transport and archive controls; the two sources never share panel state.
Borders establish structure; shadows are reserved for transient or detached surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal means listening, active, or healthy; red means recording or failure; amber means caution; blue is reserved for keyboard focus and connection progress.

rules.name: The White Field Rule
rules.body: The transcript and settings reading surfaces remain white. Cool gray separates navigation and compact-window material without turning sections into floating cards.

rules.name: The Translation Leads Rule
rules.body: Source text remains readable but subordinate; translated text receives the strongest weight and scale on every subtitle surface.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Persistent page sections never use decorative shadows. Elevation communicates detachment or temporary feedback, not importance.

dos: Do keep computer audio and microphone content on independent pages.
Do group committed sentences into continuous bilingual paragraphs.
Do keep play/pause/stop and archive state independent for each source page.
Do keep operational metadata at 12px or larger and use tabular numerals for time and latency.
Do use Lucide icons, visible keyboard focus, high-contrast states, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
donts: Don't turn the source archive rail into a dashboard or nested card grid.
Don't split the transcript into current and history visual tiers.
Don't fade older compact subtitles with parent opacity.
Don't use accent colors without a capture, health, recording, warning, error, or focus meaning.
